subject: predict function on model.avg in pcount analysis

messages.author: be9a9ad2b552860e
messages.subject: predict function on model.avg in pcount analysis
parts:
Hi,

I'm writing to you because I have a problem using the "predict" function starting from an averaged model (obtained from "model.avg" function) of pcount analyses.

The results show that I have eleven models enclosed in 4 points of AIC. Therefore, I decided to make an averaged model using the first eleven models.

The "model.avg" function needs 'a fitted model object or a list of such objects, or a "model.selection" object’, so I used a fitList object obtained with all my models for model.avg function

 

models2_eg <- fitList('dm2.0'  = dm2.0_eg_c,
                      'dm2.2'  = dm2.2_eg,
                      'dm2.3'  = dm2.3_eg,
                      'dm2.4'  = dm2.4_eg,
                      'dm2.4_b'  = dm2.4_eg_b,
                      'dm2.5'  = dm2.5_eg,
                      'dm2.5_b'  = dm2.5_eg_b,
                      'dm2.5_c'  = dm2.5_eg_c,
                      'dm2.5_d'  = dm2.5_eg_d,
                      'dm2.6'  = dm2.6_eg,
                      'dm2.6_b'  = dm2.6_eg_b,
                      'dm2.6_c'  = dm2.6_eg_c,
                      'dm2.7'  = dm2.7_eg,
                      'dm2.8'  = dm2.8_eg,
                      'dm2.9'  = dm2.9_eg,
                      'dm2.10'  = dm2.10_eg,
                      'dm2.10_b'  = dm2.10_eg_b,
                      'dm2.11'  = dm2.11_eg,
                      'dm2.11_b'  = dm2.11_eg_b)

 

best.md_2eg2 <- model.avg(models2_eg, subset=delta<4)

 but R give me back this error

 > best.md_2eg2 <- model.avg(models2_eg, subset=delta<4) Error in model.avg.default(models2_eg, subset = delta < 4) : oggetto "delta" non trovato

this is very wired because the models2_eg structure contains the "delta" information.

Hence, I tried to use "dredge" function (MuMin package), and it seems that model.avg works fine. The problems arrive when I try to make a predict function....it gives me back this error

 > pred2_tot <-predict(best.md_2eg,nd2_tot,type="state", append=T) Error in predict.averaging( best.md_2eg,nd2_tot,type="state", append=T): can predict only from 'averaging' object containing model list

In the end, I tried to use a simple list indicating manually the models that were good for me (delta<4). Also in this case, the model.avg function seems to wors fine, but as for dredge object, the predict function does not work.

Anybody can help me?

I really appreciate any helpful suggestions.

Thanks!

Michele

messages.author: 4f80e1927b0757cb
messages.subject: Re: predict function on model.avg in pcount analysis
parts:
Hi Michele,

This is more of a MuMIN question since both model.avg() and dredge() are MuMIn functions. MuMIn has some support for unmarked but it doesn't always work perfectly in my experience. Try putting your models into a regular list (not a fitList) and running model.avg() and predict() on that list instead.

Ken
